mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_keys (video_id, source_id, key_data, key_iv, created_at) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{sourceId}, #{keyData}, #{keyIv}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_id = VALUES(source_id), key_data = VALUES(key_data), key_iv = VALUES(key_iv)
mapper.select: SELECT id, video_id, source_id, key_data, key_iv, created_at FROM video_keys WHERE video_id = #{videoId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, video_id, source_id, key_data, key_iv, created_at FROM video_keys WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} LIMIT 1
